attchmntText: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the outcome of the Board Meeting held on 13.11.2026.
voiceSummary: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. The standalone auditor report notes several matters. The company is settling a resolution plan amount of INR 2100 Lacs. A provision of Rs 70.47 lacs was made for estimated credit loss. Profit was understated by INR 8 Lakh for the quarter due to unaccounted gratuity and leave encashment provisions. Rental income of INR 8 Lakh was not accounted for. Revenue includes INR 1056 Lakh in unbilled revenue and INR 99.78 Lakh from an arbitration award. Unbilled revenue stands at INR 1480 Lakh. The consolidated auditor report carries a qualified conclusion. This is due to issues in subsidiary Tantia Infrastructure Private Limited regarding a loan of INR 543.83 Lakh. It also cites issues in step-down subsidiary Tantia Raxaultollway Private Limited. This subsidiary has an abandoned project with a pending arbitration claim of INR 98618 Lakh against NHAI. Bank facilities for this subsidiary are classified as non-performing assets.

attchmntText: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the outcome of the BM to approve the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026

Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Intimation of Board Meeting under Regulation 29 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
